title: Ohanashi no Tsuzuki wa, Mata Ashita.

alternative_titles.en: You're Going to Love Tomorrow's Story.
alternative_titles.ja: お話の続きは、また明日。

synopsis:
''The Story of the Blue, Blue Night.

An arranged version of the ending theme that was only included in the 2023 Nintendo Switch™ package version. To commemorate the 6th anniversary of Unreal Life's release, we are presenting it with a newly drawn animated music video by Totorika!''

(Source: Official YouTube Channel)
